newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end down on mild profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end down on mild profit-taking.

text.p: Thai stocks closed slightly lower in moderate trade on Tuesday as investors sold large capitalised energy and bank stocks to take profits, brokers said.

"The index eased after the market reopened in the afternoon. Some investors feared the monthly economic indicators to be released by the central bank on Thursday would show no improving signs," said a broker at a foreign brokerage house.
The SET index ended 2.33 points lower at 739.75 on 4.3 billion baht turnover.
The SET-50 index slipped 0.25 point to 54.73. Gainers led decliners 161 to 118 while 115 issues ended unchanged.

The broker said the market was volatile on Tuesday on mixed market sentiment. "Some investors thought the key economic indicators being released would improve while many didn't think so," the broker said.
Bangkok Bank topped the active list, gaining three baht to 177, coal miner Banpu slipped 10 to 420, and PTT Exploration fell 14 to 326.
